title: Polynomial loop termination configuration
statement: For natural numbers $c,C,q$ with $q>0$, run the specified unary Boolean Turing machine on the empty input from the configuration with loop control at index $c$, all work heads at zero, and empty output. After $\mathrm{cost}(q,C,c+1)+1$ steps, the machine is halted in the configuration with advance control at its last index, all work heads at zero, and output consisting of $Cq^{c+1}$ true bits; its tape contents and input-head position are those of the specified catalog configuration.
